articles.title: The Score: Constellation, Chevron, Lockheed Martin and More Stocks That Defined the Week
articles.mainIdea: The Score: Constellation, Chevron, Lockheed Martin and More Stocks That Defined the Week
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: The Score: Constellation, Chevron, Lockheed Martin and More Stocks That Defined the Week. The Modelo and Corona importer reported lower quarterly sales and profit as customers, particularly Hispanic consumers, continue to buy less beer. Constellation cited weak consumer sentiment and rising unemployment rates, as well as a downturn in “4,000-calorie jobs,” or physically demanding jobs such as construction, that typically boost beer sales. Constellation shares rose 5.3% Thursday. Related tickers mentioned: AAPL, CVX, LMT, STZ.
